key.name: watch-list
key.description: Package names to check against Bodhi before they are considered safe to install. Packages not found in Bodhi (e.g. RPM Fusion builds) are flagged as untracked rather than silently treated as safe.

key.name: min-stable-age-days
key.description: Minimum number of days a watched package must have been pushed to Bodhi's stable repo before it is no longer flagged as risky.
